scope: Native admission support checks; counts are not original-instruction differential vectors

cases.return_qualification: Quiet original-style API returns0 on both success and error; denial established by path rejection and unchanged bytes/metadata

loader.scope: Exact input identity and resulting native memory are compared. Rejected malformed inputs stop at the exact-fingerprint gate; this does not exercise each deeper parser branch.

memory.model: Independent Python byte-address model: every byte masks(segment*16+offset+byte_index,20bits). Full native memory compared after reads/writes.
memory.scope: Infrastructure accessors, not original instruction bodies; direct typed DS lvalues remain outside this test.

division.scope: Native division guard against an independent integer quotient/fault model; not an original x86-body comparison.

paths.source_inputs: Synthetic file fixtures only; actual reference originals are never passed to candidate write/path APIs.
paths.scope: Read/create resolution, explicit disjoint roots, basic Win32 filename rules and existing hardlink rejection. No adversarial concurrent filesystem race or complete final-host acceptance.
